reborn-0089.rationale: Current English card text omits an explicit Damage Step clause, while the engine description says the trigger cannot activate during the Damage Step. Official Japanese Neuron Q&A for Ambulanceroid explicitly states that its Trigger Effect does not target and cannot be activated during the Damage Step. The exact pinned Lua registers a normal optional EVENT_TO_HAND trigger without Damage Step-enabling properties and only Special Summons a 'roid' that was added from the controller's GY to hand, matching that official ruling. The added engine wording therefore describes correct executable behavior rather than a simulator mismatch.

note: Script-hash-bound review resolving Ambulanceroid's omitted English Damage Step restriction using official Japanese Neuron Q&A.
